subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: What Control UI media policy should govern remote images, audio/video playback, and web previews from chat content now that direct/local image rendering is partly supported?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally block remote image/media fetches, while this request asks for richer inline rendering that changes browser privacy, CSP, and user-consent boundaries.

options.title: Keep safe default, design opt-in/proxy path
options.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob defaults and implement any remote image or web preview support only through an approved proxy, explicit opt-in, or bounded metadata API.

options.title: Allow direct remote media rendering
options.body: Accept third-party fetch exposure and update renderer, sanitizer, CSP, docs, and browser proof together for direct remote image/media loads.

options.title: Split and close the umbrella later
options.body: Keep this issue open only until remote images, web previews, and audio policy are explicitly accepted or rejected in narrower canonical issues.

recommendation.title: Keep safe default, design opt-in/proxy path
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob defaults and implement any remote image or web preview support only through an approved proxy, explicit opt-in, or bounded metadata API.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch/CSP security boundary that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
